pageProps.title: Hero (2022)
pageProps.review: A review of the movie Hero, which tells the story of Ahn Jung-geun, conveying a heavy emotion given by the sense of duty to face historical facts that should not be forgotten and the powerful message of 'Who is the sinner?'
pageProps.content:
## Review I felt that it should definitely be seen as a musical rather than a movie. However, I watched it with a sense of duty to face historical facts that must not be forgotten. If I get the chance, I should definitely watch the musical.
Who is the sinner!
